description: Unified knowledge base for laparoscopic surgical actions, including instruments, verbs, targets, and valid triplets.

grasper.name: grasper
grasper.description: A surgical instrument used to grasp, hold, retract, and manipulate tissue.

bipolar.name: bipolar
bipolar.description: A bipolar electrosurgical instrument commonly used for coagulation and dissection.

hook.name: hook
hook.description: An electrosurgical hook used for dissection, cutting, and coagulation.

scissors.name: scissors
scissors.description: A surgical cutting instrument used mainly for cutting and dissection.

clipper.name: clipper
clipper.description: A clip applicator used to place surgical clips on vessels or ducts.

irrigator.name: irrigator
irrigator.description: A surgical suction and irrigation instrument.

grasp.name: grasp
grasp.description: Grasping or holding tissue with a surgical instrument.

retract.name: retract
retract.description: Pulling or holding tissue away to expose the surgical field.

coagulate.name: coagulate
coagulate.description: Applying energy to tissue or vessels to achieve hemostasis.

clip.name: clip
clip.description: Applying a surgical clip to a vessel or duct.

cut.name: cut
cut.description: Dividing tissue using a cutting instrument.

aspirate.name: aspirate
aspirate.description: Removing fluid from the surgical field.

irrigate.name: irrigate
irrigate.description: Washing the surgical field with fluid.

pack.name: pack
pack.description: Placing or manipulating material for packing.

null_verb.name: null_verb
null_verb.description: Special verb indicating no action (for placeholder).

cystic_plate.name: cystic_plate
cystic_plate.description: The connective tissue plate surrounding the cystic duct and artery.

cystic_duct.name: cystic_duct
cystic_duct.description: The duct connecting the gallbladder to the biliary tree.

cystic_pedicle.name: cystic_pedicle
cystic_pedicle.description: The bundle containing the cystic duct and artery.

fluid.name: fluid
fluid.description: Bodily fluid present in the surgical field.

abdominal_wall_cavity.name: abdominal_wall_cavity
abdominal_wall_cavity.description: The interior surface of the abdominal wall.

specimen_bag.name: specimen_bag
specimen_bag.description: A bag used to retrieve resected tissue.
